/* SQL ID : SbjctDAO.selectSbjctOfringAccess 설 명 : 과목개설 접근 권한 체크용 조회 */ SELECT A.SBJCT_ID , B.ORG_ID , A.PROF_ID , A.ATNDLC_CERT_STSCD , A.SBJCT_TYCD FROM TB_LMS_SBJCT A INNER JOIN TB_LMS_SMSTR_CHRT B ON B.SMSTR_CHRT_ID = A.SMSTR_CHRT_ID WHERE A.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND A.DELYN = 'N'

/* SQL ID : SbjctDAO.selectSbjctOfring 설 명 : 과목개설 상세 조회 */ SELECT A.SBJCT_ID , A.PROF_ID , A.SBJCT_REF_TYCD , A.CRS_MSTR_ID , A.SMSTR_CHRT_ID , A.SBJCT_GBNCD , A.CRS_GBNCD , A.SBJCT_TYCD , A.EDU_MTHD_TYCD , A.RGLRYN , A.CRCLMN_NO , A.SBJCTNM , A.SBJCT_EXPLN , A.SBJCT_ENNM , A.SBJCT_YR , A.SBJCT_SMSTR , A.CRDTS , A.RVW_PSBL_GBNCD , A.RVW_SDTTM , A.RVW_EDTTM , A.DVCLAS_GRPCD , A.DVCLAS_NO , A.DVCLAS_NCKNM , A.WHOL_WK_CNT , A.CMCRS_GBNCD , A.EVL_GBNCD , A.LRN_CNTRL_GBNCD , A.FNSH_PROC_MTHD_CD , A.FNSH_SCR , A.FNSH_SCR_DELRT , A.ETC_DELRT , A.ATNDC_DELRT , A.ASMT_DELRT , A.DSCS_DELRT , A.EXAM_DELRT , A.TEAM_ACTV_DELRT , A.SBJCT_LCTR_SDTTM , A.SBJCT_LCTR_EDTTM , A.ATNDLC_APLY_MTHD_CD , A.ATNDLC_QUOTA , A.ATNDLC_CERT_STSCD , A.ATNDLC_APLY_SDTTM , A.ATNDLC_APLY_EDTTM , A.ATNDLC_SDTTM , A.ATNDLC_EDTTM , A.AUDIT_SDTTM , A.AUDIT_EDTTM , A.SBJCT_LATE_RECG_DTTM , A.MRK_PROC_SDTTM , A.MRK_PROC_EDTTM , A.MRK_EVL_GBNCD , A.MRK_INQ_SRVY_ID , A.USEYN , A.DELYN , A.KYWD , A.LCTR_FRMT_GBNCD , A.RGTR_ID , A.REG_DTTM , A.MDFR_ID , A.MOD_DTTM , A.LCTR_GBNCD , A.CRCLMN_NO AS SBJCT_CD , A.LCTR_EVLYN , A.LCTR_PRVW_WKNO , A.PASSFAIL_SCR , B.ORG_ID , B.SMSTR_CHRTNM AS TERM_NM , ORG.ORGNM , CRS_GBNCD_CD.CDNM AS CRS_GBNCDNM , SBJCT_TYCD_CD.CDNM AS SBJCT_TYCDNM , LCTR_GBNCD_CD.CDNM AS LCTR_GBNCDNM , CMCRS_GBNCD_CD.CDNM AS CMCRS_GBNNM , EVL_GBNCD_CD.CDNM AS EVL_GBNCDNM , LCTR_FRMT_GBNCD_CD.CDNM AS LCTR_FRMT_GBNCDNM , LRN_CNTRL_GBNCD_CD.CDNM AS LRN_CNTRL_GBNCDNM , ATNDLC_APLY_MTHD_CD.CDNM AS ATNDLC_APLY_MTHD_CDNM , ATNDLC_CERT_STSCD_CD.CDNM AS ATNDLC_CERT_STSCDNM , RVW_PSBL_GBNCD_CD.CDNM AS RVW_PSBL_GBNCDNM /* 공개강좌 기본정보 팝업의 미리보기 버튼에서 사용할 콘텐츠 URL을 조회한다. */ , ( SELECT MAX(C.CONTS_URL) FROM TB_LMS_LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL W JOIN TB_LMS_LCTR L ON L.LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL_ID = W.LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL_ID AND NVL(L.DELYN, 'N') = 'N' JOIN TB_LMS_LCTR_CONTS C ON C.LCTR_ID = L.LCTR_ID WHERE W.SBJCT_ID = A.SBJCT_ID AND NVL(W.DELYN, 'N') = 'N' AND C.CONTS_URL IS NOT NULL ) AS LESSON_CNTS_URL FROM TB_LMS_SBJCT A INNER JOIN TB_LMS_SMSTR_CHRT B ON B.SMSTR_CHRT_ID = A.SMSTR_CHRT_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_ORG ORG ON ORG.ORG_ID = B.ORG_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_CMMN_CD CRS_GBNCD_CD ON CRS_GBNCD_CD.LANG_CD = NVL(#{langCd}, 'ko') AND CRS_GBNCD_CD.UP_CD = 'CRS_GBNCD' AND CRS_GBNCD_CD.CD = A.CRS_GBNCD LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_CMMN_CD SBJCT_TYCD_CD ON SBJCT_TYCD_CD.LANG_CD = NVL(#{langCd}, 'ko') AND SBJCT_TYCD_CD.UP_CD = 'SBJCT_TYCD' AND SBJCT_TYCD_CD.CD = A.SBJCT_TYCD LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_CMMN_CD LCTR_GBNCD_CD ON LCTR_GBNCD_CD.LANG_CD = NVL(#{langCd}, 'ko') AND LCTR_GBNCD_CD.UP_CD = 'LCTR_GBNCD' AND LCTR_GBNCD_CD.CD = A.LCTR_GBNCD LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_CMMN_CD CMCRS_GBNCD_CD ON CMCRS_GBNCD_CD.LANG_CD = NVL(#{langCd}, 'ko') AND CMCRS_GBNCD_CD.UP_CD = 'CMCRS_GBNCD' AND CMCRS_GBNCD_CD.CD = A.CMCRS_GBNCD LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_CMMN_CD EVL_GBNCD_CD ON EVL_GBNCD_CD.LANG_CD = NVL(#{langCd}, 'ko') AND EVL_GBNCD_CD.UP_CD = 'EVL_GBNCD' AND EVL_GBNCD_CD.CD = A.EVL_GBNCD LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_CMMN_CD LCTR_FRMT_GBNCD_CD ON LCTR_FRMT_GBNCD_CD.LANG_CD = NVL(#{langCd}, 'ko') AND LCTR_FRMT_GBNCD_CD.UP_CD = 'LCTR_FRMT_GBNCD' AND LCTR_FRMT_GBNCD_CD.CD = A.LCTR_FRMT_GBNCD LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_CMMN_CD LRN_CNTRL_GBNCD_CD ON LRN_CNTRL_GBNCD_CD.LANG_CD = NVL(#{langCd}, 'ko') AND LRN_CNTRL_GBNCD_CD.UP_CD = 'LRN_CNTRL_GBNCD' AND LRN_CNTRL_GBNCD_CD.CD = A.LRN_CNTRL_GBNCD LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_CMMN_CD ATNDLC_APLY_MTHD_CD ON ATNDLC_APLY_MTHD_CD.LANG_CD = NVL(#{langCd}, 'ko') AND ATNDLC_APLY_MTHD_CD.UP_CD = 'ATNDLC_APLY_MTHD_CD' AND ATNDLC_APLY_MTHD_CD.CD = A.ATNDLC_APLY_MTHD_CD LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_CMMN_CD ATNDLC_CERT_STSCD_CD ON ATNDLC_CERT_STSCD_CD.LANG_CD = NVL(#{langCd}, 'ko') AND ATNDLC_CERT_STSCD_CD.UP_CD = 'ATNDLC_CERT_STSCD' AND ATNDLC_CERT_STSCD_CD.CD = A.ATNDLC_CERT_STSCD LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_CMMN_CD RVW_PSBL_GBNCD_CD ON RVW_PSBL_GBNCD_CD.LANG_CD = NVL(#{langCd}, 'ko') AND RVW_PSBL_GBNCD_CD.UP_CD = 'RVW_PSBL_GBNCD' AND RVW_PSBL_GBNCD_CD.CD = A.RVW_PSBL_GBNCD WHERE A.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND A.DELYN = 'N'
mapper.update: /* SQL ID : SbjctDAO.deleteSbjctOfring 설 명 : 과목개설 삭제(논리삭제) */ UPDATE TB_LMS_SBJCT SET DELYN = 'Y' , MDFR_ID = #{mdfrId} , MOD_DTTM = FN_DTTM() WHERE SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND DELYN = 'N'
mapper.select: /* SQL ID : SbjctDAO.admSbjctOfringAdmUserList 설 명 : 과목개설 과목관리자 등록용 사용자 목록 조회 */ WITH BASE_USER AS ( SELECT U.USER_ID , U.STDNT_NO , U.USERNM , U.USER_TYCD FROM TB_LMS_USER U WHERE U.USER_TYCD IN ('PROF', 'COPROF', 'TUT', 'ASSI') AND U.USERNM LIKE FN_LIKE_VAL(#{searchValue}) ) SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY U.USERNM, U.USER_ID) AS LINE_NO , U.USER_ID , U.STDNT_NO , U.USERNM , U.USER_TYCD , USER_TYCD_CD.CDNM AS USER_TYCDNM , CNTCT.MBL_PHN , CNTCT.EML FROM BASE_USER U LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_CMMN_CD USER_TYCD_CD ON USER_TYCD_CD.LANG_CD = NVL(#{langCd}, 'ko') AND USER_TYCD_CD.UP_CD = 'USER_TYCD' AND USER_TYCD_CD.CD = U.USER_TYCD LEFT JOIN ( SELECT UC.USER_ID , MAX(CASE WHEN UC.CNTCT_TYCD = 'MBL_PHN' THEN UC.CNTCT END) AS MBL_PHN , MAX(CASE WHEN UC.CNTCT_TYCD = 'INDV_EML' THEN UC.CNTCT END) AS EML FROM TB_LMS_USER_CNTCT UC WHERE UC.CNTCT_TYCD IN ('MBL_PHN', 'INDV_EML') AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM BASE_USER BU WHERE BU.USER_ID = UC.USER_ID ) GROUP BY UC.USER_ID ) CNTCT ON CNTCT.USER_ID = U.USER_ID ORDER BY U.USERNM, U.USER_ID

/* SQL ID : SbjctDAO.admSbjctOfringAdmList 설 명 : 과목개설 과목관리자 목록 조회 */ WITH BASE_ADM AS ( SELECT ADM.SBJCT_ADM_ID , ADM.SBJCT_ID , ADM.USER_ID , ADM.SBJCT_ADM_TYCD , ADM.RGTR_ID , ADM.REG_DTTM , ADM.MDFR_ID , ADM.MOD_DTTM , ADM.SBJCT_ADM_SEQNO , U.USERNM , U.STDNT_NO , U.USER_TYCD FROM TB_LMS_SBJCT_ADM ADM INNER JOIN TB_LMS_SBJCT CUR ON CUR.SBJCT_ID = ADM.SBJCT_ID AND CUR.DELYN = 'N' INNER JOIN TB_LMS_USER U ON U.USER_ID = ADM.USER_ID WHERE ADM.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} ) SELECT ADM.SBJCT_ADM_ID , ADM.SBJCT_ID , ADM.USER_ID , ADM.SBJCT_ADM_TYCD , ADM.RGTR_ID , ADM.REG_DTTM , ADM.MDFR_ID , ADM.MOD_DTTM , ADM.SBJCT_ADM_SEQNO , ADM.USERNM , ADM.STDNT_NO , ADM.USER_TYCD , USER_TYCD_CD.CDNM AS USER_TYCDNM , CNTCT.MBL_PHN , CNTCT.EML FROM BASE_ADM ADM LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_CMMN_CD USER_TYCD_CD ON USER_TYCD_CD.LANG_CD = NVL(#{langCd}, 'ko') AND USER_TYCD_CD.UP_CD = 'USER_TYCD' AND USER_TYCD_CD.CD = ADM.USER_TYCD LEFT JOIN ( SELECT UC.USER_ID , MAX(CASE WHEN UC.CNTCT_TYCD = 'MBL_PHN' THEN UC.CNTCT END) AS MBL_PHN , MAX(CASE WHEN UC.CNTCT_TYCD = 'INDV_EML' THEN UC.CNTCT END) AS EML FROM TB_LMS_USER_CNTCT UC WHERE UC.CNTCT_TYCD IN ('MBL_PHN', 'INDV_EML') AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM BASE_ADM BA WHERE BA.USER_ID = UC.USER_ID ) GROUP BY UC.USER_ID ) CNTCT ON CNTCT.USER_ID = ADM.USER_ID ORDER BY ADM.SBJCT_ADM_SEQNO, ADM.REG_DTTM, ADM.SBJCT_ADM_ID

/* SQL ID : SbjctDAO.admSbjctOfringStdntUserList 설 명 : 과목개설 수강생 등록용 학생 목록 조회 */ WITH CUR_SBJCT AS ( SELECT CUR.SBJCT_ID , CUR.SMSTR_CHRT_ID , CUR.CRCLMN_NO , CUR_SC.ORG_ID FROM TB_LMS_SBJCT CUR INNER JOIN TB_LMS_SMSTR_CHRT CUR_SC ON CUR_SC.SMSTR_CHRT_ID = CUR.SMSTR_CHRT_ID WHERE CUR.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND CUR.DELYN = 'N' ), BASE_USER AS ( SELECT U.USER_ID , U.USERNM , U.STDNT_NO FROM TB_LMS_USER U INNER JOIN CUR_SBJCT CUR ON 1 = 1 WHERE U.USER_TYCD = 'STDNT' AND U.USERNM LIKE FN_LIKE_VAL(#{searchValue}) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_LMS_ATNDLC ATNDLC INNER JOIN TB_LMS_SBJCT S ON S.SBJCT_ID = ATNDLC.SBJCT_ID AND S.DELYN = 'N' INNER JOIN TB_LMS_SMSTR_CHRT SC ON SC.SMSTR_CHRT_ID = S.SMSTR_CHRT_ID WHERE ATNDLC.USER_ID = U.USER_ID AND S.SBJCT_ID != CUR.SBJCT_ID AND SC.ORG_ID = CUR.ORG_ID AND S.SMSTR_CHRT_ID = CUR.SMSTR_CHRT_ID AND S.CRCLMN_NO = CUR.CRCLMN_NO ) ) SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY U.USERNM, U.STDNT_NO, U.USER_ID) AS LINE_NO , U.USER_ID , U.USERNM , U.STDNT_NO , CNTCT.MBL_PHN , CNTCT.EML FROM BASE_USER U LEFT JOIN ( SELECT UC.USER_ID , MAX(CASE WHEN UC.CNTCT_TYCD = 'MBL_PHN' THEN UC.CNTCT END) AS MBL_PHN , MAX(CASE WHEN UC.CNTCT_TYCD = 'INDV_EML' THEN UC.CNTCT END) AS EML FROM TB_LMS_USER_CNTCT UC WHERE UC.CNTCT_TYCD IN ('MBL_PHN', 'INDV_EML') AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM BASE_USER BU WHERE BU.USER_ID = UC.USER_ID ) GROUP BY UC.USER_ID ) CNTCT ON CNTCT.USER_ID = U.USER_ID ORDER BY U.USERNM, U.STDNT_NO, U.USER_ID

/* SQL ID : SbjctDAO.admSbjctOfringStdntList 설 명 : 과목개설 수강생 목록 조회 */ WITH BASE_ATNDLC AS ( SELECT ATNDLC.ATNDLC_ID , ATNDLC.SBJCT_ID , ATNDLC.USER_ID , ATNDLC.RPTYN , ATNDLC.ATNDLC_STSCD , ATNDLC.RGTR_ID , ATNDLC.REG_DTTM , ATNDLC.MDFR_ID , ATNDLC.MOD_DTTM , U.USERNM , U.STDNT_NO FROM TB_LMS_ATNDLC ATNDLC INNER JOIN TB_LMS_SBJCT CUR ON CUR.SBJCT_ID = ATNDLC.SBJCT_ID AND CUR.DELYN = 'N' INNER JOIN TB_LMS_USER U ON U.USER_ID = ATNDLC.USER_ID AND U.USER_TYCD = 'STDNT' WHERE ATNDLC.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} ) SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY U.USERNM, U.STDNT_NO, U.USER_ID) AS LINE_NO , U.ATNDLC_ID , U.SBJCT_ID , U.USER_ID , U.RPTYN , U.ATNDLC_STSCD , U.RGTR_ID , U.REG_DTTM , U.MDFR_ID , U.MOD_DTTM , U.USERNM , U.STDNT_NO , CNTCT.MBL_PHN , CNTCT.EML FROM BASE_ATNDLC U LEFT JOIN ( SELECT UC.USER_ID , MAX(CASE WHEN UC.CNTCT_TYCD = 'MBL_PHN' THEN UC.CNTCT END) AS MBL_PHN , MAX(CASE WHEN UC.CNTCT_TYCD = 'INDV_EML' THEN UC.CNTCT END) AS EML FROM TB_LMS_USER_CNTCT UC WHERE UC.CNTCT_TYCD IN ('MBL_PHN', 'INDV_EML') AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM BASE_ATNDLC BA WHERE BA.USER_ID = UC.USER_ID ) GROUP BY UC.USER_ID ) CNTCT ON CNTCT.USER_ID = U.USER_ID ORDER BY U.USERNM, U.STDNT_NO, U.USER_ID
mapper.delete: /* SQL ID : SbjctDAO.deleteSbjctOfringStdntList 설 명 : 과목개설 수강생 목록 삭제 */ DELETE FROM TB_LMS_ATNDLC ATNDLC WHERE ATNDLC.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_LMS_USER U WHERE U.USER_ID = ATNDLC.USER_ID AND U.USER_TYCD = 'STDNT' )
